verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a feature-flag platform, but the evidence pack never documents an open-source or self-hosted distribution of Statsig. Local SDK evaluation and Warehouse Native (analysis that runs in your own data warehouse) are adjacent features. Neither one lets you self-host the flag platform itself, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can self-host the full flag platform from an open-source distribution, keeping evaluation data on my infrastructure
